lens: Conversion-form engineer (progressive enhancement, mailto encoding, accessible validation)
reads: research/cedar-springs-teardown-blueprint.md (moved from the repo root at the seed commit)
deliverables: Six inputs: services (4 multi-select cards), municipality <select> of 13 (+ "somewhere else"), description, timing (ASAP / this season / planning ahead), name, best way to reach you (email / call / text; phone field appears and becomes required for call or text)

?area= / ?service= prefill; form action = mailto (method=post enctype=text/plain) so it works without JS; subject "Free quote request — X — Y"; URL body ≤ 1,800 chars (truncate + tell them to paste the copied full text)
Ready panel: Copy request (role=status confirmation), address + copy button, Call / Text (only when PHONE known), Gmail / Outlook web compose links
Native validation + inline errors (aria-describedby) + error summary on submit; values never cleared; sessionStorage draft
Plausible events (CONTRACT §Analytics events) with no personal data; pure builder functions exported from quote.js and unit-tested
acceptance: A13#10: ≈6 inputs, single name field, no CAPTCHA — verified by e2e/quote.spec#six-inputs
C2.5: Free quote page wireframe — verified by e2e/quote.spec#page-order
C5.1: Quote builder six inputs, ?area= prefill — verified by e2e/quote.spec#prefill
C5.2: mailto submit with encoded subject/body ≤ 1,800 chars; works without JS — verified by unit/quote-builder.test#mailto
C5.3: Ready panel: copy, address, call/text, webmail links — verified by e2e/quote.spec#ready-panel
C5.4: Native validation, inline errors, error summary, values kept — verified by e2e/quote.spec#validation
C5.5: sessionStorage draft — verified by e2e/quote.spec#draft-restore
C5.6: Plausible custom events, no personal data — verified by unit/quote-events.test#no-pii
P1#5: Quote builder → mailto, no-JS path, copy, visible email, tel/sms fallbacks + status — verified by e2e/quote.spec#no-js-and-fallbacks
Free-quote page order: H1 → reassurance strip ([REPLY TIME]) → builder → What happens next (3) → alternative contacts → privacy note
gates: cd $WT/site && node tools/dev-setup.mjs --devtools   # once it exists (W1 build); before that: tsc --typeRoots /opt/node-tools/node_modules/@types
node build.mjs --offline-images --out=$OUT && SITE_DIST=$OUT node tools/check-all.mjs --no-build [--strict-redirects from W1 ia on]
PORT=$PORT SITE_DIST=$OUT node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --trace off
node tools/a11y.mjs --themes=dark,light --widths=320,1440 --motion=off,on   # once qa lands; until then axe via the global helper
verifierLens: Mail-client pessimist: length caps, encoding of non-ASCII, no-JS submit, back-navigation draft restore, screen-reader error flow
portRule: builder = port; reviewer = port + 10; fixer = port + 20; evidence collector 4400
returns: {branch, head, base, files, gates, acceptance[], requests[]}
requests: .orchestra/requests/quote.md (never edit a file outside owns; describe the change there)
